service.en: Visa for companions of GCC citizens
service.ur: خلیجی شہریوں کے ساتھیوں کے لیے ویزا

about: Get a 60-day visa for a companion of a GCC citizen who is hosting them.
aliases: Visa for domestic worker of GCC citizen
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Visa for companions of GCC citizens. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The host must be a GCC national and must be present when the companion arrives at an entry point
The GCC residence of the beneficiary must be valid for at least 1 year
Passport valid for at least 6 months
Saudi and Omani citizens do not pay the issuance fee
documents: Valid GCC residence permit with the companion's sponsor file
Proof of identity of the GCC citizen
fees: Issuance 100 AED, waived for Saudi and Omani citizens
channels: ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS)
